records.event: Unusual 'outer-space-type music' / whistling while in lunar orbit
records.status: reported phenomenon; generally associated with radio/VHF interaction, no visual craft claim in the event record
records.next: Add exact onboard transcript/audio timestamps and RF configuration.

records.event: Bright unidentified object during translunar coast
records.evidenceClass: postflight technical debrief; multiple crew observers
records.status: unidentified in crew debrief; S-IVB rejected by reported distance; spacecraft-origin debris not ruled out
notes: Aldrin described an L-like appearance through the monocular.
Armstrong compared the appearance to an open suitcase.
Armstrong emphasized the object was near the visual resolution limit and size/range were not established.
